description: This file defines the AWS Lambda client class, LambdaClient, which extends AwsClient. It includes method annotations for various Lambda operations and a middleware setup for default cURL options.

classes.name: LambdaClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AWS Lambda, extending AwsClient and adding middleware for cURL options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the client and appends default cURL options middleware if the curl extension is loaded.

methods.name: getDefaultCurlOptionsMiddleware
methods.description: Provides middleware to set default cURL options, specifically enabling TCP keepalive.
